translations.translatedText: # Monday 30.1.2017 (radio)
Trump angers the world. A mosque was attacked in Canada. A big factory fire in Pori. Many dangerous electrical devices were found in shops.
## Trump's decisions cause anger
![Donald Trump](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9432122)
Open image viewer
Donald Trump's decision on restrictions for people entering the country angers the world.  Photo: Olivier Douliery / EPA
US President Donald Trump's decisions are now being talked about a lot around the world.

For example, Trump has banned citizens of Iraq, Iran, Yemen, Libya, Somalia, Sudan and Syria from travelling to the USA. Now it is said that people from the banned countries can still get into the USA if the person has already got a US residence permit.

Trump's decisions have caused anger in different parts of the world. Finland's President Sauli Niinistö does not accept Trump's decision. Niinistö says that labelling people according to their nationality is wrong.

German Chancellor Angela Merkel says that Trump's decision is unfair to Muslims. British Prime Minister Theresa May does not accept Trump's ban. The EU is still thinking about what the decisions mean.
In the USA, tens of thousands of people have demonstrated, for example in Washington and New York. President Trump defends the decision to ban travel to the USA from 7 Muslim countries.
## A terror attack on a mosque in Quebec
![The shooting site sealed off by police, the Islamic cultural centre of Quebec City.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9430834)
Open image viewer
The terror attack on the mosque happened when prayer time began.  Photo: Alice Chiche / AFP
A mosque has been attacked in Quebec City in Canada. At least 6 people have died and many have been injured.
Several men came into the mosque when it was time for evening prayer. The men started shooting at the people praying. There were about 40 people in the mosque when the attack was carried out.
The police have arrested two people. Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau has said that the attack was a terror attack.
## A big factory fire in Pori
![Huntsman fire](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9431527)
Open image viewer
The fire is in a big factory in Pori.  Photo: Karri Laihonen / Yle

There has been a big fire in Pori all day. The fire started in the morning in a factory that makes products, for example, for paint factories. The fire has destroyed much of the roof of the big factory.  About 150 firefighters and a helicopter have been putting out the fire.

The factory is a workplace for 460 people. The workers have not been injured in the fire. The fire has produced thick smoke. Residents have been told that they should stay indoors and close their ventilation.
There is no danger of an explosion in the fire.
## Many electrical devices can be dangerous
![A charger uses electricity even when the device being charged has been unplugged.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5647887)
Open image viewer
Last year the authorities had to take many electrical devices off the market.  Photo: YLE
Last year the authorities took many electrical devices off the market. According to the authorities, the devices were dangerous or they were not of proper quality.
For example, LED lamps and power adapters for electrical devices were taken off the market. The authorities say that devices nowadays have many faults because many devices are made in Asia.
